reviews.title: "From Team NGL"
reviews.text: For the most part- the app does what you'd expect it to- it has good features for an anonymous question app with additional features locked behind a paywall instead of the core functionality locked behind said paywall. That being said, the "From Team NGL"questions" are incredibly misleading. Firstly- the app never asked you if you want to do those- it just automatically throws them at you from the start- and secondly they don't read like starter questions, they read like a real person is asking you questions/saying something to you- which is very misleading. One said to me "someone's still not over u lol" which not only isn't a question- but implies that this is an ex messaging me- WHEN IT'S JUST THE APP??? there needs to be some sort of disclaimer letting you know that they do that or an opt in button at the beginning instead of just quietly having it on.
